requirements.statement: PASS, COMPLETE, VERIFIED, HEALTHY, INSTALLED, DEPLOYED, and RELEASED claims shall cite current evidence bound to exact scope and candidate identity.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Canonical gate states shall be PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, NOT_RUN, INCONCLUSIVE, STALE, INVALID_REPORT, or WAIVED_WITH_APPROVED_EXPIRY; legacy accepted-risk states migrate to PASS plus an explicit risk/waiver record.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Health shall distinguish healthy, degraded, partial, dependency-failed, unknown, untested, stale, misconfigured, and root-cause-unknown, and shall test the reporter itself.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability
